choice.initial: Pinned isolated R process invoking the maintained native C++ core.
choice.direct_native: Deferred until ownership, preprocessing, aggregation, serialization and environment parity are qualified.
choice.port: Reject for the initial scope: transfers forest and statistical maintenance without a measured workload benefit.

scope.target: E[Y(1)-Y(0)] in the declared customer population, estimated by all-sample AIPW scores; not mean fitted CATE.
scope.law: Complete independent customer rows; one binary action, one fixed scalar outcome and horizon.
scope.assumption_status: Declared premises; neither syntax nor fitting verifies them.

initial_options.seed: Required integer, recorded; no default random draw

scope.nuisance: Retain R OOB nuisance path; optional declared known randomized propensity only. Supplied fitted nuisances need a separately qualified provenance/split profile.
excluded: Weights or clusters in initial profile
External fitted nuisance vectors in initial profile
scope.extension: Independent-cluster all-sample AIPW design retains cluster units and target weights; no current admission or few-cluster coverage.

request.configuration: Versioned immutable engine_configuration ArtifactRef: source, options, roles, units, target, seed and numerical policy. Detailed options are not added to generic parameters.
request.data: Authorized local immutable handles only; verify bytes, schema and hash. Preserve row IDs and ordered feature names; no caller executable or network locator.
request.identity: Context digest plus full request digest including all data/configuration/environment identities; never cache by scientific context alone.
request.graph: Preserve graph and set topology and all endpoint marks; no arbitrary representative DAG. Require an applicable target-identification argument before estimation.

conversion.R_boundary: Original X,Y,W sent to R; R residualizes Y and W before native call. Record nuisance vectors and provenance.
conversion.native_boundary: Borrowed column-major double buffer [X,Y_residual,W_residual,...]; own memory for full call/thread lifetime; checked size multiplication and role indices.
conversion.roles: Outcome/treatment/instrument/weight setters exclude role columns from splitting; causal binding sets instrument index to treatment index.
conversion.units: No silent scaling. Output unit equals Y unit for binary 1-minus-0 contrast; variances have squared units, SEs original units.
conversion.query_coordinates: Conditional prediction artifact retains query-row IDs, feature order and out-of-bag versus newdata distinction; not individual counterfactual effects.
conversion.serialization: RcppUtilities::serialize_forest consumes tree unique_ptrs; do not reuse original. Deserialize into new object. Bind nuisance/training/feature/option/environment identities alongside model; no stable native ABI claim.

statistics.ATE: Weighted average of scores for an explicitly named population; initial q_i=1.
statistics.variance: ATE std.err is already square-rooted; conditional variance.estimates is a variance. Neither excess.error nor mean CATE variances supplies ATE variance.
statistics.cluster_extension: G/(G-1) sum_g[sum_i_in_g q_i(Gamma_i-theta)]^2 / (sum_i q_i)^2; G positive-weight clusters. Independent-cluster law and nuisance conditions required.
statistics.weak_support: Reject boundary/invalid propensities and nonfinite scores; declared profile alarms never silently trim or retarget. Native denominator diagnostics required before a direct-native route.
statistics.qualification: After engineering admission only execution_only with no confidence object. Conditional/asymptotic uncertainty needs its own construction evidence; no simultaneous or uniform guarantee inferred.

responses.unavailable: Current state: engine/dependency/admission receipt absent; no numeric result.
responses.unsupported: Recognized query outside profile; explain sampling/target mismatch and reviewed alternative.
responses.refused: Support or identification prerequisites fail under declared profile; retain diagnostics and target.
responses.not_identified: Only with an audited identification failure; inability of adapter is not proof.
responses.failed: Nonfinite result, corrupt model, subprocess error, timeout or resource failure; no partial numeric estimate.
responses.computed: Only admitted runtime result with original context and units, scalar AIPW target, provenance; uncertainty no stronger than bound evidence.
responses.sets: Preserve unknown/empty/disconnected/unbounded sets from applicable methods; this forest route cannot fabricate a finite interval for them.

deployment.declared_build: R >=3.5.0; C++17; GNU make; LinkingTo Rcpp/RcppEigen; imports DiceKriging,lmtest,Matrix,methods,Rcpp,sandwich; versions locked at admission.
deployment.native_build: Inspected CMake builds an executable with src and test sources; shared-library ABI remains unqualified.
deployment.environment: Record source/binary/compiler/flags/R/dependency/thread/RNG/global-option hashes and versions; declarations do not prove installed compatibility.
deployment.rights: DESCRIPTION GPL-3; inspected source headers GPL-3-or-later; preserve file and dependency terms, review distribution obligations before release.
deployment.isolation: One worker per local R process; native global runtime_context writes require separate shared-embedding concurrency review.
deployment.faults: Parent-enforced wall/memory/output budget, bounded logs, atomic complete publication. No mid-tree resume; immutable replay only. Cross-environment bitwise equality unclaimed.

admission_sequence: Freeze complete source/dependencies/rights and a local runtime environment.
Implement profile validator and request/result conversions with unavailable/unsupported/refusal/fault paths.
Compare actual R execution with exact fixtures and source-correct AIPW/variance oracle; validate serialization/reload, coordinates and units.
If needed implement native route and match R preprocessing, options, predictions and aggregation; include lifetime and failure trials.
Profile full workflow; prospectively register generated-data study for any coverage/performance claim.
Run registered study retaining failed requests; report scoped results and conditional next experiment.

reference_evidence.anchor: Ten exact arithmetic comparisons; five reference rejections; no grf execution

limits: No source completeness/ABI or statistical qualification
No bank validation or product acceptance
